page.layout: One column of running text at left; narrow column of marginal notes at right of the text block, separated by a rule. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword at right below the last line, gathering signature at bottom left.

main_text.p: ratoris personam semel aggredi, aut ab eo deficere ; licèt tum temporis Christianam fidem profiterentur : tum Procopius ducalem in oriente sublimitatem à Diocletiano nastus, tum {1}Philoromus, qui primariam dignitatem apud Alexandrinos consecutus, vt Romanorum mos fuit, satellitibus stipatus, in dies singulos de controuersijs ad se relatis iudicium tulit. Et certè Alexandriæ cùm Imperaret ( nisi reclamasset conscientia ) nullo cum negotio ita naues onerarias potuisset intercludere, vt tota Italia breui spatio fame fuisset e-nećta & absorpta : præsertim cùm, teste {m}Lactantio, illo lacteo eloquentiæ flumine, qui hanc persecutionem præsens viderat: Ab ortu solis vsque ad occa-sum Lex diuina suscepta esset, omnis ætas, sexus, gens, regio, vnitis ac pa-ribus animis Deo seruirent : de obe-dientia tamen Imperatori interim præ-stita audi ipsum Lastantium ; Defen-denda est religio, non occidendo, sed moriendo ; non sæuitia sed patientia ; non sce-lere, sed fide. Audi {n}Arnobium, La-stantij Præceptorem. Nostra Scripta cur

page.notes: Marginal notes (right): "1 Eufeb. li. 8.ca.10.", "m Lib.5. cap.13.", "n Lib.4. Contra gentes in fine." Notes were written as note elements beside their references in the text. The text was transcribed with long s rendered as plain s, as required. Doubtful readings: "nastus" (printed as is, probably "natus"); "Dioclesiano" set in italic; "Lactantio" and "Arnobium" in italic. The "s" in "stipatus" and "suscepta" was rendered as plain s. The superscript marks {m} and {n} are reference marks; their notes are in the right margin. The "Ioan." and "Lib." abbreviations are as printed. "Procopius" is printed with a hyphenated line break ("Pro-copius") and is written here as one word.
